install: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements.txt; else [ -d .venv ] || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; fi && (sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true) && LINE="export PATH=\"$PWD/.venv/bin:\$PATH\"" && (grep -qxF "$LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$LINE" >> ~/.bashrc)
